name: dbt-spec-driven
description: Spec-driven dbt development workflow. One workflow skill (spec-driven): explicit discovery, open decisions settled one question at a time with a recommendation (accepted automatically in scheduled mode), build against the mandatory standards in AGENTS.md, then sub-agents for output validation, peer review and CI interpretation. No spec files are written to the repo. Includes a CI failure responder for automated bug-fix via dbt Cloud webhooks. Cortex-only.
